# Test plan
## Acceptance coverage
AC-1: duplicate completion unit case, expected RED at baseline; AC-2: company B owner receives none, expected RED. Both required.
## Unit tests
completion.test.ts tests describe('AC-1 duplicate event') and describe('AC-2 tenant boundary'). Fake repository stores rows keyed by company/application/owner; assertions inspect final rows and scoped calls. Do not mock the completion handler.
## Regression
Existing notification read permissions suite remains unchanged and must stay GREEN.
## Required evidence
Required notifications-unit profile: nonzero executed tests, per-criterion behavioral RED then final GREEN. Local integration uses A/B companies. Existing tests may change only for explicit contract changes, with requirement rationale and renewed approval. No scaffold required.
